items.title: ByteDance launches Seedance 2.5 4K video model for film production
items.headline: ByteDance launches Seedance 2.5 4K video model for film production
items.excerpt: Volcano Engine's Seedance 2.5 4K targets film and TV production with 10-bit color, better facial expressions and fine detail, and a 480p Draft mode for testing shots and storyboards before final 4K renders. It is in trials with selected enterprise customers.
items.rationale: Concrete new model release aimed at film/TV finishing (4K, 10-bit, cheap 480p draft pass) that changes previz-to-final workflows; no prior Seedance 2.5 4K card.

items.title: ByteDance launches AI studio for short-drama production
items.headline: ByteDance launches AI studio for short-drama production
items.excerpt: ByteDance's Jimeng AI launched a short-drama studio that puts script development, character and scene creation, storyboarding, video production and post into one workflow, using its in-house DreamScript, Anycook and DreamShot models.
items.rationale: New end-to-end production product (script to post) for the microdrama format the section has tracked as a trend; a product launch, distinct from the 10-21 microdrama market report.

items.title: Oscars Will 'Always' Reward Human Excellence in AI Era, Academy Chiefs Say
items.headline: Oscars Will 'Always' Reward Human Excellence in AI Era, Academy Chiefs Say
items.excerpt: Academy president Lynette Howell Taylor tells Variety in Tokyo that the Oscars will keep honoring human-driven work as AI spreads through filmmaking, while leadership leaves the door open to tweaking international feature rules.
items.rationale: Academy leadership's on-record stance on AI and awards eligibility is a signal every filmmaker using AI tools needs; fresh (10-28) and not covered before.

items.title: Rintaro On Anime's Aversion To Risk: 'There Will Be No Future'
items.headline: Rintaro On Anime's Aversion To Risk: 'There Will Be No Future'
items.excerpt: At Busan, the 'Galaxy Express 999' and 'Metropolis' director ties anime's remake culture to generative AI, arguing AI 'recommends the mean or the average' and pushes toward remaking past works instead of creating something new.
items.rationale: A legendary anime director's specific critique linking generative AI to remake culture; animation voice and outlet diversity, distinct from earlier Busan AI cards.

items.title: Singapore Media Festival Launches Creator Summit as Asia TV Forum Adds AI Zone, Microdrama Focus
items.headline: Singapore Media Festival Launches Creator Summit as Asia TV Forum Adds AI Zone, Microdrama Focus
items.excerpt: ATF adds 'The AI Era | Entertainment Reimagined' strand and zone on AI in content creation, IP rights and regulation, plus the final round of AI Hackathon 2026 with a live creative contest and screenings.
items.rationale: New program announcement from a different market (Singapore ATF) than the Busan ACFM story it loosely resembles; gives the section a market/events slot.
